title: Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution: A Closed Two-Stage Framework for Precise and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.03385v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In robotic manipulation, the tight coupling between grasping and motion planning often obscures the true source of failure, leading to inefficient trial-and-error. To enable efficient long-horizon manipulation, we propose GTP-FA (Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution), a task-oriented two-stage 'grasp-then-plan' framework that generates grasp candidates and performs downstream motion planning conditioned on the selected grasp. Given a failed manipulation trajectory, we learn a failure attribution model that generalizes to unseen grasps and produces a stable distribution over failure modes for diagnosis-guided optimization. Based on these attribution results, we then optimize both modules in a diagnosis-driven manner: on the grasping side, we inject task-level priors and risk penalties into grasp candidate scoring and optimization to suppress unstable or task-incompatible grasps; on the planning side, we target high-risk init

translated_title: 先抓取后规划与失败归因：一个用于精确且可泛化机器人操作的闭环两阶段框架
translated_abstract: 在机器人操作中，抓取与运动规划之间的紧密耦合常常掩盖失败的真正原因，导致低效的反复试错。为实现高效的长时程操作，我们提出了GTP-FA（带失败归因的先抓取后规划），这是一个面向任务的两阶段“先抓取后规划”框架，该框架生成抓取候选，并以所选抓取为条件执行下游运动规划。给定一条失败的操作轨迹，我们学习一个失败归因模型，该模型可泛化至未见过的抓取，并产生稳定的失败模式分布，用于诊断引导的优化。基于这些归因结果，我们以诊断驱动的方式对两个模块进行优化：在抓取方面，我们向抓取候选的评分与优化中注入任务级先验和风险惩罚，以抑制不稳定或与任务不兼容的抓取；在规划方面，我们针对高风险初始……
tldr: 提出GTP-FA两阶段“先抓取后规划”框架，利用失败归因模型诊断操作失败原因，并以诊断驱动的方式联合优化抓取与运动规划模块，实现精确且可泛化的机器人长时程操作。
en_tdlr: GTP-FA is a two-stage grasp-then-plan framework that employs a failure attribution model to diagnose manipulation failures and diagnosis-driven optimization of both grasping and motion planning modules for precise and generalizable robotic manipulation.
